findings.evidence: `nl -ba` shows the declaration at line 368 and the conclusion at line 370; the same file already has `SymplecticForm.neg_eq` at line 359. Mathlib naming rules say theorem names describe their conclusions and namespaced definitions should not be redundantly prefixed when already in the namespace.
findings.fix: Either state the composed-map invariant and name it `comp_almostComplexStructure`, or keep this statement and rename it after the conclusion, e.g. a `neg_...`/`neg_eq` variant.
findings.issue: `SymplecticForm.symplecticForm_comp_almostComplexStructure` is in the `SymplecticForm` namespace and its conclusion contains no `comp`; it is just `-ω (F (J₀.toLinearMap v)) (F v) = ω (F v) (F (J₀.toLinearMap v))`, i.e. `ω.neg_eq`.

summary: One new exported symplectic-form lemma has a misleading name: it advertises a composition/source-rotation invariant but states only the existing skew-symmetry equality.
